title: Admissibility of drawback in case of rejection of application
text: 4.29 Admissibility of drawback in case of rejection of application Customs authorities in terms of Do R rules against shipping bills filed and processed under an Advance Authorisation, in case application for an Advance Authorisation is rejected or modified by Regional Authority, may permit drawback.
intent: Support Admissibility of drawback in case of rejection of application processing and compliance validation.
tags: Admissibility of drawback in case of rejection of application
